1: There's a yellow tag on a machine at work that says one word: warning.
2: Whoever wrote that tag wasn't being mean. He was trying to keep my hand.
3: Moreover by them is thy servant warned:
4: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
6: God's Word does two things, David says. It warns you, and it rewards you.
7: A warning isn't God being hard on you. It's God keeping your hand whole.
8: I've ignored some warnings in my life. Every one costs more than reading it would have.
9: The reward isn't only heaven later. It's a clear head tonight, a house still standing.
10: Today, read the warning before you touch the machine. One chapter before one app.
11: Let's pray. Father, thank You for warning us before the trouble, not after.
12: Open our eyes to the Word today, and give us the grit to keep it.
13: And let us taste the reward You promised. In Jesus' name, amen.
14: Follow Blessed Prayers so the Word finds you on the hard days. Drop an amen.
15: Keep the Word for today. Have a blessed day.
